# PROMPT 01B
# GAMEPLAY REALITY AUDIT

Version: 1.0

Status: Mandatory

Priority: CRITICAL

Depends On:

- 01A.0-source-discovery.md
- 01A-reference-atlas.md
- 01-validation-infrastructure.md

Blocks:

- Prompt 02
- Prompt 03
- Prompt 04
- Prompt 05
- Prompt 06
- Prompt 07
- Prompt 08
- Prompt 09

---

# PURPOSE

Validate the actual implementation of the game against assumptions made by the production pipeline.

The objective is to prevent production, validation and integration work from being driven by incorrect assumptions.

This prompt validates:

- actual gameplay
- actual renderer behavior
- actual animation usage
- actual runtime states
- actual atlas contents

This prompt does NOT create any new sprite.

This prompt does NOT modify any existing sprite.

This prompt does NOT integrate any change.

This prompt only establishes verified reality.

---

# BACKGROUND

Previous reviews revealed that several assumptions about the project were incorrect.

Examples:

- INTERACT was assumed to be a real animation family.
- COLLECT was assumed to be a potential carry cycle.
- PUSH was assumed to be a dedicated state.
- CLIMB was assumed to be a dedicated state.
- Toy Room carry behavior was assumed to use a carry animation.

Gameplay inspection disproved these assumptions.

Future production must be based on verified facts.

Never assumptions.

---

# AUDIT RULES

Inspect:

- source atlas
- OFFICIAL_FRAMES
- runtime behavior
- renderers
- state machines
- gameplay systems

All findings must be supported by evidence.

---

# AUDIT AREA 01
# INTERACT

## Objective

Determine whether INTERACT is a real animation family.

---

## Validation

Inspect:

- atlas extraction
- OFFICIAL_FRAMES
- runtime references
- renderer usage

---

## Questions

How many frames exist?

Are multiple frames present?

Is a complete animation cycle present?

Is the state referenced by gameplay?

Is the state animated?

---

## Deliverables

Generate:

interact-sheet.png

interact-report.md

interact-report.json

---

## Classification

Choose exactly one:

REAL_STATE

or

ISOLATED_ARTIFACT

---

## Failure Indicators

Single frame only.

Partial crop.

Residual pixels.

Unused extraction.

Runtime not referencing state.

---

# AUDIT AREA 02
# COLLECT

## Objective

Determine whether COLLECT may be used as a carry reference.

---

## Validation

Inspect:

- collect frames
- runtime usage
- renderer usage
- gameplay meaning

---

## Questions

Is collect a locomotion state?

Can the player move while collect plays?

Does collect contain idle?

Does collect contain run?

Does collect contain jump?

Does collect contain fall?

---

## Deliverables

collect-sheet.png

collect-analysis.md

collect-analysis.json

---

## Classification

Choose exactly one:

VALID_REFERENCE

or

NON_REFERENCE

---

## Failure Indicators

Single pickup gesture.

Single celebration gesture.

Static transitional pose.

No locomotion support.

---

# AUDIT AREA 03
# TOY ROOM TRANSPORT

## Objective

Determine how transport currently works.

---

## Validation

Inspect:

ToyRoomEntities

ToyCarryPresentation

renderToyCarry

runtime footage

renderers

---

## Questions

What sprite is displayed during transport?

Is a carry cycle used?

Does movement animate?

Does runtime use a placeholder?

Does runtime use run[4]?

---

## Deliverables

transport-runtime.gif

transport-state-report.md

transport-state-report.json

---

## Classification

Choose exactly one:

FULL_CARRY_EXISTS

or

PLACEHOLDER_IMPLEMENTATION

---

## Failure Indicators

Position changes.

Character moves.

Body does not animate.

Single frame displayed.

Static pose used for transport.

---

# AUDIT AREA 04
# PUSH

## Objective

Determine whether PUSH is a dedicated state.

---

## Validation

Compare:

PUSH

versus

idle[0]

---

## Questions

Unique pixels?

Unique animation?

Unique runtime usage?

Unique frames?

Unique renderer logic?

---

## Deliverables

push-analysis.md

push-analysis.json

push-comparison.png

---

## Classification

Choose exactly one:

REAL_STATE

or

ALIAS

---

# AUDIT AREA 05
# CLIMB

## Objective

Determine whether CLIMB is a dedicated state.

---

## Validation

Compare:

CLIMB

versus

idle[0]

---

## Questions

Unique pixels?

Unique animation?

Unique runtime usage?

Unique frames?

Unique renderer logic?

---

## Deliverables

climb-analysis.md

climb-analysis.json

climb-comparison.png

---

## Classification

Choose exactly one:

REAL_STATE

or

ALIAS

---

# AUDIT AREA 06
# GAMEPLAY STATE INVENTORY

## Objective

Build a verified inventory of animation families actually available.

---

## Outputs

Generate:

runtime-state-inventory.md

runtime-state-inventory.json

---

## Required Fields

State name

Atlas source

Frame count

Runtime usage

Renderer usage

Animation type

Status

---

## State Status

SUPPORTED

PARTIAL

ALIAS

ARTIFACT

MISSING

---

# AUDIT AREA 07
# PIPELINE IMPACT REVIEW

## Objective

Identify prompts affected by incorrect assumptions.

---

## Outputs

Generate:

pipeline-impact-review.md

---

## Required Sections

Assumption

↓

Reality

↓

Affected Prompt

↓

Required Correction

---

## Example

INTERACT

↓

artifact

↓

Prompt 02

↓

remove dependency

---

## Example

COLLECT

↓

pickup gesture

↓

Prompt 02

↓

cannot be considered carry source

---

## Example

Toy Room Carry

↓

run[4] placeholder

↓

Prompt 08

↓

requires dedicated carry integration

---

# VERIFIED FACTS

Generate:

verified-gameplay-facts.md

---

## Required Format

FACT-001

Statement

Evidence

---

FACT-002

Statement

Evidence

---

The goal is to create a permanent repository of verified gameplay truths.

---

# REQUIRED DECISIONS

The audit must answer:

Is INTERACT a production target?

YES / NO

---

Is COLLECT a carry reference?

YES / NO

---

Does a real carry state already exist?

YES / NO

---

Does PUSH require future production?

YES / NO

---

Does CLIMB require future production?

YES / NO

---

Does Toy Room currently use a carry cycle?

YES / NO

---

# APPROVAL CRITERIA

All audit areas completed.

All evidence generated.

All reports generated.

All classifications assigned.

All verified facts documented.

Pipeline impact review completed.

---

# FAILURE CRITERIA

Missing evidence.

Missing audit area.

Assumptions presented as facts.

Runtime behavior not inspected.

State classifications absent.

---

# BLOCKING RULE

Prompt 02 may not begin until this audit is approved.

Any prompt that assumes nonexistent animation families must be revised before execution.

---

# REQUIRED OUTPUTS

interact-report.md

collect-analysis.md

transport-state-report.md

push-analysis.md

climb-analysis.md

runtime-state-inventory.md

pipeline-impact-review.md

verified-gameplay-facts.md

gameplay-reality-audit.md

gameplay-reality-audit.json

---

# FINAL GOAL

All future animation work must be based on:

actual gameplay

actual renderer behavior

actual state usage

actual atlas contents

actual runtime evidence

Never on labels.

Never on comments.

Never on assumptions.
